articles.summary: "Just adding AI" has burned a lot of founders, PMs, and enterprises adopting AI products. This post proposes a set of alternative principles that define what it means to be "AI Native".

articles.summary: Computer-use demos are impressive, but agentic automation with tools outperforms by 10x. METR's research reveals AI agent workflows struggle with long action sequences-making agentic process automation with tool-first design the path to reliable agents.

articles.summary: AI intelligence is jagged-superhuman at coding and research, stumbling at basic tasks. This post proposes five principles for building products that ride those edges without pretending the gaps don't exist.
articles.title: Principles of Building Along the Jagged Edges of LLM Intelligence
